candidates.hypothesis: Rapidly brightening transient (Nova or early SN)

history.note: Continued consistent brightening (1.10 mag). Position stable. Alert criteria met.

decision.reasoning: CAND_01 appears to be reaching its peak brightness at magnitude 8.63, showing a slower rate of brightening compared to previous observations. The 17 secondary detections are clustered within 25 pixels of the primary source and are rejected as PSF artifacts and subtraction residuals caused by the extreme brightness of the transient.
